records.text: In a post read by Owens, Laura Loomer said a photo taken at a New York City DMV showed a Palestinian-flag credit-card-machine screensaver on October 7, and accused Mamdani of deliberate, intentional conduct.
records.speaker: Laura Loomer

appearances.snippet: This is so funny. She wrote, this was just sent to me. The photo was taken at a DMV today in New York City. ... Why does the credit card machine at the DMV in Mamdani (Zohran Mamdani)'s New York City have the Palestinian flag as the screensaver on October 7th? ... Mamdani (Zohran Mamdani), disgraceful. It is deliberate and intentional.
